question: The word “dichotomy” most nearly means:

options.text: A division between two opposing sides

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "A division between two opposing sides".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dichotomy"** refers to a division or contrast between two things that are entirely different or opposed. (विरोधाभास या द्विभाजन)

 
 
• **Example:** There is often a dichotomy between what politicians promise and what they deliver.
 
 
 
• **"Dichotomy"** is used to describe situations, thoughts, or things that are starkly divided into two distinct and contrasting parts. (द्वैतता)
 
 
• **Example:** The dichotomy between rural and urban lifestyles is evident in their traditions and pace of life.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shared belief** (साझा विश्वास): Refers to ideas or beliefs that are commonly held by a group of people.

 
 
• **Example:** A shared belief in equality brought the community together.
 
 
 
• **Combined benefit** (सामूहिक लाभ): Refers to an advantage or profit gained collectively.
 
 
• **Example:** The merger resulted in a combined benefit for both companies.
 
 
 
• **A repeated pattern** (दोहराया गया पैटर्न): Refers to something that occurs again and again in the same way.
 
 
• **Example:** The repeated pattern of waves crashing on the shore was mesmerizing.
 
 

45:Tb09,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**&
